answer: Have every claim answered twice: the submitter posts the work, then an unrelated peer must reproduce it from the same inputs and the two must match in structure. Any divergence flags the pair, and a pair that echoes too closely flags both as copied. Standing is then sealed in onyx, a dense opaque entry recording the echoed history without exposing raw data, so a clone cannot fabricate a matching echo. The whole channel is finally checked as a sonnet, a fixed form where every line must scan and rhyme with the ones before it, so one broken line voids the entry.
